$comment: Read by scripts/verify-uifn-version-bump.mjs. inputs: repo paths outside a stable package that feed its tarball; a shipped change to them needs that package's version bump. references: out-of-root paths its shipped files or lifecycle scripts name that do not feed the tarball. excluded: paths inside the package that are not shipped. Every entry maps a path to the reason.

inputs.uifn/catalog/generated/catalog.json: scripts/build.mjs generates dist/primitive-entries from the catalog.

excluded.scripts/dev.mjs: Watch-mode helper for npm run dev; no lifecycle script runs it.
